result.stdout:
Description:
  Sitefinity Command Line Utility (CLU)

Usage:
  sf-clu [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  -genkeys             Generate public/private key set for authenticating API calls
  -gensync <targets>   Generate Site Sync Configuration
  -remote <key=value>  Build, deploy, recycle or check the site on a Windows build host over SSH
